entities.name: Russiore
entities.description: City on the northeast coast of Gulmany, ruled by a prince.

entities.name: Gulmany
entities.description: Great island of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Phyrexian-born sleeper-hunter who came to Russiore to plant anti-sleeper traps.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Dropped Xantcha off at Russiore and later collected her.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: Xantcha's lover, whose thoughts saved her from Gix.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who recognized Xantcha and nearly converted her back with mind control.

entities.name: Pincar City
entities.description: City near Efuan Pincar with a temple of Avohir.

entities.name: Temple of Avohir
entities.description: Temple in Pincar City where Xantcha found Phyrexian sleeper agents.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose sleeper agents Xantcha found.

events.summary: Xantcha comes to Russiore to plant anti-sleeper agent traps after Urza drops her off.
events.quote: Xantcha came to Russiore to plant anti- sleeper agent traps after being dropped off by Urza

events.summary: In Pincar City Xantcha stumbles upon Phyrexian sleeper agents in the temple of Avohir.
events.quote: she stumbled upon Phyrexian sleeper agents in the temple of Avohir

events.summary: Gix recognizes Xantcha and nearly converts her back to Phyrexia, but thoughts of Ratepe save her and she escapes.
events.quote: He almost managed to convert her back to Phyrexia through mind control, but the thoughts of Ratepe saved her

events.summary: Xantcha spends eight days setting sleeper traps before Urza collects her.
events.quote: She spent the next eight days, thoroughly shaken, setting the sleeper traps in the seacoast principality

relations.quote: an errand given by her lover, Ratepe

relations.note: Tried to convert her back to Phyrexia.
relations.quote: He almost managed to convert her back to Phyrexia through mind control

relations.note: City on the northeast coast of Gulmany.
relations.quote: Russiore lies on the northeast coast of Gulmany
